docs.file_summary: `lock.go` defines `BundleEntry`, `Lockfile`, `ReadLockfile` and `WriteLockfile`. It is imported by 5 files (2 of them tests). Of the others, 3 are in `internal/cli`.

content.text:
ANSWER: Three CLI command files in `internal/cli` call `lock.ReadLockfile` (defined at `pkg/lock/lock.go:45`), so a change to the okf.lock on-disk format would affect them:

1. **`internal/cli/pull.go` → `cmdPull`** (line 41). It calls `lock.ReadLockfile(lockPath)` at line 160.
2. **`internal/cli/restore.go` → `runRestore`** (line 58). It calls `lock.ReadLockfile("okf.lock")` at line 64.
3. **`internal/cli/vendor.go` → `cmdVendor`** (line 29). It calls `lock.ReadLockfile("okf.lock")` twice, at lines 37 and 62. `cmdVendor` is the only function in that file that could contain line 62.

The repowise search marked this list of calls as complete. Two test files also call it and would need updating: `internal/cli/restore_test.go` (`TestCmdVendor_RemovePrefixSafeguard`, line 106) and `pkg/lock/lock_test.go` (`TestLockfile_ReadWriteUpsert`, line 29). `WriteLockfile` in `pkg/lock/lock.go` would need to change too, so that reading and writing still use the same format.

CONFIDENCE: high
